title: AC1018 generated TABLE typed-grid and cached-geometry readback
question: Does the bounded generated AC1018 TABLE whole-file control verify every typed cell value, row/column dimension, merge role, and its existing *T cached-geometry graph after fresh readback?

finding.change: Extended the existing whole-file TABLE control to check all nine cell contents and content types, all three column widths and row heights, and the merged title anchor/covered-cell roles after reading the emitted DWG with a fresh libdxfrw reader.
finding.existing_graph_checks: The selector also checks the TABLESTYLE NOD/dictionary path, TABLE-to-*T BLOCK_RECORD relation, reverse INSERT membership, and all 15 ordered cached LINE/MTEXT children including text and geometry fields.
finding.scope: Generated AC1018 plain-text TABLE writer/readback regression coverage only. The authored model and child geometry are local controls; this does not independently decode TABLE cell semantics from a producer file or prove native rendering.
finding.fixtures: No drawing fixture was added. The test creates its DWG in a temporary directory and removes it after the run.

limitations: The generated control is not producer-backed interoperability evidence.
The physical AC1018 peer's TABLE cell body remains opaque to the independent reader; native AutoCAD/ODA acceptance and rendering remain open.
No broader source profile, strict whole-document output route, or support claim is promoted.
